*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Visual, low-speed controller for the live coffee-push episode.
+
+The controller uses the supplied target and calibrated top camera view. It
+keeps the fingers open and advances the end-effector in small Cartesian steps.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import math
+import os
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+DT = 0.0125
+
+
+def get_xyz(r: Robot) -> np.ndarray:
+    p = r.get_obs(cameras=["topview"], include_depth=False, video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"]
+    return np.asarray(p[:3], dtype=float)
+
+
+def execute_rows(r: Robot, rows: np.ndarray, label: str):
+    rows = np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float64)
+    if not len(rows):
+        return None
+    res = r.submit("ee_delta", rows, dt=DT, interpolate="hold",
+                   cameras=["topview", "right"], video_fps=10, video="frames", note=label)
+    idx = {k: i for i, k in enumerate(res.meta.get("proprio_layout", []))}
+    if res.proprio is not None and len(res.proprio):
+        print(label, "steps", res.meta.get("control_steps"), "last proprio", res.proprio[-1, :7].tolist())
+    print(label, "meta", json.dumps({k: res.meta.get(k) for k in ("control_steps", "time_left_s", "done", "reason")}, sort_keys=True))
+    if "topview" in res.last:
+        from PIL import Image
+        Image.fromarray(res.last["topview"]).save(OUT / (label.replace(" ", "_") + "_top.png"))
+    return res
+
+
+def move_to(r: Robot, xyz, grip=-1.0, max_step=0.0025, settle=12, label="move"):
+    """Move the mocap target along a straight Cartesian segment, in small steps."""
+    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=["topview"], include_depth=False, video="none")
+    p = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    start = p[4:7]
+    goal = np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float)
+    d = goal - start
+    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(float(np.max(np.abs(d))) / max_step)))
+    native = d / (n * 0.01)
+    rows = np.tile(np.r_[native, grip], (n, 1))
+    rows = np.vstack((rows, np.tile([0.0, 0.0, 0.0, grip], (settle, 1))))
+    print(label, "from", start.tolist(), "to", goal.tolist(), "rows", len(rows))
+    return execute_rows(r, rows, label)
+
+
+def observe(r: Robot, label="observe"):
+    o = r.get_obs(cameras=["front", "left", "right", "topview"], include_depth=True, video="none")
+    from PIL import Image
+    for cam, im in o.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(im).save(OUT / f"{label}_{cam}.png")
+    np.savez_compressed(OUT / f"{label}_depth.npz", **o.depth)
+    print(json.dumps({"meta": o.meta, "proprio": o.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now")}, default=lambda x: x.tolist() if hasattr(x, "tolist") else str(x), indent=2))
+    return o
+
+
+def prealign(r: Robot):
+    """Raise above the mug, then descend behind it without making contact."""
+    # Initial overhead image estimates mug centre near (0.04, 0.55) m.
+    move_to(r, [0.004, 0.400, 0.235], label="lift")
+    move_to(r, [0.040, 0.495, 0.235], label="over_mug")
+    move_to(r, [0.040, 0.495, 0.090], label="lower_behind")
+    observe(r, "pre_push")
+
+
+def push_to_target(r: Robot, target, start_tcp, push_rate=0.0015):
+    """Push along the measured start-to-target vector and stop at the goal."""
+    target = np.asarray(target, dtype=float)
+    start_tcp = np.asarray(start_tcp, dtype=float)
+    # Mug centre initially sits slightly ahead of the TCP. Preserve that offset
+    # when choosing the terminal TCP position.
+    mug_offset = np.array([-0.005, 0.022, 0.0])
+    finish_tcp = target - mug_offset
+    d = finish_tcp - start_tcp
+    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(float(np.max(np.abs(d[:2]))) / push_rate)))
+    native = d / (n * 0.01)
+    rows = np.tile(np.r_[native, -1.0], (n, 1))
+    print("push", "tcp start", start_tcp.tolist(), "tcp finish", finish_tcp.tolist(), "rows", n)
+    return execute_rows(r, rows, "push_1")
+
+
+def main():
+    phase = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "prealign"
+    r = Robot()
+    spec = r.spec()
+    print("connected", spec["protocol"], "control_dt", spec["control_dt"])
+    o = observe(r, "initial")
+    target = np.asarray(o.meta["task"]["target_pos"], dtype=float)
+    print("target", target.tolist(), "time_left_s", o.meta.get("time_left_s"))
+    if phase == "prealign":
+        prealign(r)
+    elif phase == "push":
+        push_to_target(r, target[:2].tolist() + [0.090], [0.040, 0.535, 0.090])
+    elif phase == "inspect":
+        observe(r, "inspect")
+    else:
+        raise ValueError("phase must be prealign, push, or inspect")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
